description: This file defines an interface for an in-memory stream queue grain in the Orleans framework. It declares methods for enqueuing and dequeuing messages, intended for use within a distributed actor model system.

classes.name: IMemoryStreamQueueGrain
classes.description: Interface for an in-memory stream queue grain, providing methods to enqueue and dequeue memory messages.

methods.name: Enqueue
methods.description: Adds a memory message to the queue.

methods.name: Dequeue
methods.description: Retrieves up to maxCount memory messages from the queue.
